workflow_steps.title: Join ACS income attributes to census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Attach the median household income attribute table to the Centre County census-tract polygons.
workflow_steps.instructions: Join the vector and table using runtime-grounded schema fields representing the tract identifier. Do not assume field names; QC must identify the compatible join fields and verify that the income measure is present for mapping. Preserve the census-tract geometries.
